{
	"private": true,
	"type": "module",
	"engines": {
		"node": "^22.22.2 || ^24.17.0 || ^26.4.0"
	},
	"name": "backend-next",
	"scripts": {
		"build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json",
		"typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit",
		"lint": "eslint --quiet src test *.ts",
		"test": "vitest run --config vitest.config.ts",
		"test:integration": "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts",
		"test:acceptance": "vitest run --config vitest.acceptance.config.ts",
		"test:process": "vitest run --config vitest.process.config.ts",
		"migrate": "node built/entrypoints/migrate.js",
		"check-migrations": "node built/entrypoints/check-migrations.js",
		"check-schema": "node built/entrypoints/check-schema.js",
		"check-queue-handoff": "node built/entrypoints/check-queue-handoff.js",
		"start:http": "node built/entrypoints/http.js",
		"start:worker": "node built/entrypoints/worker.js",
		"start": "node built/entrypoints/supervisor.js"
	},
	"dependencies": {
		"backend-upstream": "workspace:*",
		"typeorm": "1.1.1",
		"pg": "8.23.1",
		"ioredis": "5.11.1",
		"bullmq": "6.3.11",
		"reflect-metadata": "0.2.2",
		"js-yaml": "5.4.2",
		"hono": "4.13.13",
		"@hono/node-server": "2.1.4",
		"inversify": "8.2.3",
		"ajv": "8.20.0",
		"ulid": "3.0.2",
		"ratelimiter": "3.4.1",
		"re2": "1.27.0",
		"mfm-js": "0.27.0",
		"semver": "7.8.5",
		"bcryptjs": "3.0.3",
		"node-fetch": "3.3.2",
		"hpagent": "1.2.0",
		"cacheable-lookup": "7.0.0",
		"ipaddr.js": "2.5.0",
		"jsonld": "9.0.0",
		"ws": "8.22.0",
		"meilisearch": "0.62.0",
		"node-html-parser": "9.0.4",
		"accepts": "1.3.8",
		"stringz": "2.1.0",
		"@mokurokujs/core": "0.2.0",
		"@mokurokujs/bullmq-adapter": "0.2.0",

		"vitest": "5.0.3",
		"@types/js-yaml": "4.0.9",
		"@types/ratelimiter": "3.4.6",
		"@types/semver": "7.8.0",
		"@types/jsonld": "1.5.15",
		"@types/ws": "8.18.2",
		"@types/accepts": "1.3.7",
		"@types/tinycolor2": "1.4.6"
	}
